messages:
maya: quick sanity check — I opened a tiny TF/helm change that removes the automountServiceAccountToken override from the telemetry chart to harden SA tokens. After deploying to staging I noticed the IRSA annotation on the telemetry serviceaccount disappears. PR: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/infra/pulls/4212 — can someone eyeball before I apply to staging?

alex: can you paste the SA yaml before/after? could be a templating or ordering thing. @jordan fyi.

maya: here's the snippets I captured locally:
```yaml
# before (expected)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: telemetry
  namespace: telemetry
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-telemetry
automountServiceAccountToken: false

# after deploy
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: telemetry
  namespace: telemetry
# <no annotations>
automountServiceAccountToken: true
```

jordan: if annotation is present in the chart but gone after apply, check for a mutating webhook that strips annotations (we had a bug where a webhook normalized labels/annotations). also helm helpers that create the SA only when not provided can clobber annotations.

sam: another angle: TF create/apply order. If helm_release runs before the k8s_service_account resource (or vice-versa) you can end up with a SA replace that loses annotations. search for create_before_destroy / replace strategy in the helm_release resource.

li: also saw a CI error earlier: "forbidden: cannot create serviceaccount" in a different pipeline — could be namespace-level admission or a bounded role. run `kubectl get mutatingwebhookconfiguration` and grep for anything touching serviceaccounts.

ci-bot: terraform plan (staging) returned an error while patching a k8s resource:
```
Error: resource patch failed
  on main.tf line 42, in resource "kubernetes_manifest" "telemetry_sa_patch":
  patch failed: ServiceAccount telemetry not found / annotations missing
```

maya: repro commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n telemetry get sa telemetry -o yaml  # shows no annotation
kubectl -n telemetry describe deploy telemetry-uploader  # shows saName: telemetry
```

alex: quick workaround: add a small kustomize post-patch or a tiny `kubernetes_manifest` resource that patches the SA annotation and make it depend_on the helm_release (so it runs after). will open a two-line TF change if we agree.

jordan: i'll take this. if a mutating webhook is doing it, we either add a namespace exemption in the webhook config or add a label/annotation the webhook ignores. i'll check `kubectl get mutatingwebhookconfiguration -o yaml | grep -C2 serviceAccount` and report back.

sam: :thumbsup: if you can do a hotfix patch in staging, i can smoke test telemetry ingestion.

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/infra/pulls/4212 — includes kustomize postpatch and a short TF comment about depends_on. assigning to @alex. thanks all!

ci-bot: deploy job queued to staging: build #782 — running terraform plan/apply in staging.

alex: ack, pulling in the quick patch now. will ping when staging is green.
